title: Dialysis Component | NHSN | CDC
content: Dialysis Component Print Minus Related Pages Use the Dialysis Component to access modules that focus on monitoring and reporting adverse events and process measures for the purpose of evaluating and directing prevention efforts among patients who receive dialysis in home and outpatient settings.
